field.label: Name
field.help: Letters, digits or "_". The alias is named prefix + name (for example APP_EXAMPLE).

field.label: Domains
field.help: "example.com" or "domain:example.com": the domain and its sub-domains. "full:www.example.com": this exact name. "keyword:" and "regexp:" are discovery rules: kept, but never applied by the relay. A "domain:" rule on a top-level domain or on a shared platform (CDN, cloud) is refused: use "full:" or a dedicated sub-domain.

field.label: Manual networks (CIDR)
field.help: Networks always present in the alias, for example 192.0.2.0/24 or 2001:db8::/32.

field.label: ASNs
field.help: Planned for a later version: saved but not used yet.

field.label: Address families
field.help: Families of the resolved addresses added to the alias.
